quarterly_data.signal: Fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 (annual securities report, IFRS): revenue JPY 947,749 million (+9.4%; JPY 866,032 million the year before), profit before tax JPY 327,668 million (+26.0%), profit JPY 251,451 million (+24.6%), pre-tax margin 34.6% (30.0%), ROE 25.4%. Management states sales and profits both reached record highs, helped by firm Information & Telecommunication results; profit rose sharply partly because the actual price for a future acquisition of an interest in its Chinese cataract intraocular-lens joint venture, estimated earlier and carried as a long-term financial liability, came in below that estimate as market conditions changed, and the difference was booked as a one-off gain. Segments: Life Care revenue JPY 590,680 million (+7.2%), segment profit JPY 129,531 million (+43.3%); Information & Telecommunication revenue JPY 354,751 million (+14.0%), segment profit JPY 192,325 million (+12.9%); Other (speech-synthesis software) JPY 2,318 million (-42.4%), the business was transferred in October 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: Revenue JPY 947,749 million (+9.4%); profit before tax JPY 327,668 million (+26.0%)

quarterly_data.signal: Information & Telecommunication, year ended March 2026 (annual securities report): semiconductor mask blanks rose sharply - demand stayed high and stable on development activity for advanced EUV products and DUV demand kept trending up; FPD photomasks rose sharply as the China plant ramped up; hard-disk glass substrates rose - 2.5-inch products fell sharply but 3.5-inch products were strong on firm demand for data-center nearline storage; imaging products rose sharply on stable interchangeable-lens demand for mirrorless cameras and growing sales of lenses for wearable cameras and near-infrared polarizing glass (CUPO) used in optical communications. Management states demand for semiconductor mask blanks and HDD substrates stayed high and stable. Production at selling prices: Information & Telecommunication JPY 339,428 million (106.3% of the prior year), Life Care JPY 394,941 million (100.7%), total JPY 734,369 million (103.2%); orders are not disclosed because the group mainly builds to forecast.
quarterly_data.figure: Information & Telecommunication revenue JPY 354,751 million (+14.0%); production JPY 339,428 million (106.3%)

quarterly_data.signal: Major customer (annual securities report): sales to Seagate Technology LLC were JPY 111,393 million, 11.75% of total sales, in the year ended March 2026 (JPY 92,776 million, 10.71%, the year before); the segment note places this 10%-plus customer group in the Information & Telecommunication segment.
quarterly_data.figure: Seagate JPY 111,393 million; 11.75% of FY2026 sales (FY2025: JPY 92,776 million; 10.71%)

quarterly_data.signal: Capital expenditure, year ended March 2026 (annual securities report, including intangible and right-of-use assets): JPY 65,711 million (up JPY 4,793 million). Information & Telecommunication JPY 34,195 million (+43.2%; 52% of the total), mainly to increase production of semiconductor mask blanks (management's analysis also names FPD photomask capacity); Life Care JPY 30,246 million (-16.5%; 46%), mainly eyeglass-lens capacity. Cash spent on property, plant and equipment JPY 56,581 million. Planned new facilities (rationalisation and expansion, all from own funds, no amount paid yet): electronics product facilities at HOYA Electronics Singapore (Tampines) JPY 10,890 million, HOYA Laos (Vientiane) JPY 8,168 million, HOYA Glass Disk Vietnam II (Hung Yen) JPY 7,631 million, and the Nagasaka, Hachioji and Akishima plants in Japan JPY 5,695 million; Life Care: HOYA Lamphun (Thailand) JPY 2,704 million, Japan stores and medical plants JPY 2,311 million, HOYA Lens Brazil JPY 1,027 million, HOYA Lens Thailand JPY 891 million. No significant disposals are planned.
quarterly_data.figure: Capex JPY 65,711 million (Information & Telecommunication JPY 34,195 million, +43.2%); Singapore electronics plan JPY 10,890 million

quarterly_data.signal: R&D, year ended March 2026 (annual securities report): group R&D JPY 36,291 million; Information & Telecommunication JPY 13,208 million, Life Care JPY 22,479 million. Information & Telecommunication themes: semiconductor mask blanks developed for stable supply of high-quality advanced EUV mask blanks, including blanks for phase-shift masks; functional FPD photomasks for higher-resolution panels, being brought to volume production; 3.5-inch data-center HDD substrates for stable supply, substrates for the next-generation HAMR recording method and higher-rigidity, thinner substrates for higher-capacity drives; high-performance aspheric lenses for in-vehicle and wearable cameras, smart glasses and AR, and polarizing glass for optical transceivers, which the company says has high growth potential as the AI market expands. Life Care: eyeglass-lens coatings and myopia-control lenses for children, private-brand contact lenses, compact high-resolution endoscope imaging, and multifocal and extended-depth-of-focus intraocular lenses.
quarterly_data.figure: R&D JPY 36,291 million (Information & Telecommunication JPY 13,208 million)

quarterly_data.signal: Management's analysis and strategy (annual securities report): HOYA runs a portfolio of businesses with two pillars, Life Care and Information & Telecommunication, and treats Life Care and the semiconductor- and HDD-related products of Information & Telecommunication as growth drivers. Management states that the development of high-performance, low-power semiconductors and investment in data centers are advancing with the growth of the information society, and it will actively commit resources to products that support this growth; it also continually studies and carries out responses to higher costs from tariff changes, restrictions on procuring specific raw materials and resources, and optimisation of production locations.
